Reese Witherspoon is an American actress, producer, and entrepreneur. She was born on March 22, 1976, in New Orleans, Louisiana. Witherspoon began her acting career in 1991 and gained widespread recognition for her role as Elle Woods in the 2001 film "Legally Blonde." She won the Academy Award for Best Actress for her portrayal of June Carter Cash in the 2005 film "Walk the Line."

Witherspoon is also a successful producer, having produced several films and television shows, including "Gone Girl," "Wild," and "Big Little Lies." She is the founder of Hello Sunshine, a media company that focuses on telling women's stories.

In addition to her work in entertainment, Witherspoon is also an advocate for women's rights and gender equality. She has spoken out about issues such as equal pay and representation in Hollywood.

Witherspoon has been married twice and has three children. She was previously married to actor Ryan Phillippe, with whom she has two children, and is currently married to talent agent Jim Toth, with whom she has one child.
